setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json. A test deal <deal> with a contact and a catalog quote, no invoices yet and not in the won stage; two open invoices <invoice-a> and <invoice-b> of the same test contact <contact>, each with a balance. Replace the placeholders with real names from that account.

evals.prompt: Genérale la factura al negocio <deal>, ya lo cerramos.
evals.expected_output: Finds the deal, sees it is not in the won stage and asks, previews the invoice after the user confirms, waits for a yes, generates it once and reports the invoice number, in Spanish.
expectations: Uses scripts/billing.js (preview then apply with kind fromDeal), never a hand-made POST to generatefromdeal
Tells the user the deal is not in the won stage and asks before going on; adds notWonConfirmed only after the user's yes
Shows the preview (title, dates, draft status, currency and total) and waits for an explicit yes before apply
Mentions that the Billing menu is off when the preview says so
Afterwards the deal has exactly one invoice with originDeal = the deal

evals.prompt: Registra un abono de 200.000 por transferencia a la factura <invoice-a>, lo pagaron el 28 de octubre.
evals.expected_output: Checks the invoice is open and the amount fits the balance, previews with the date in the note, records one payment after the yes and reports the new balance.
expectations: Sends paidAmount as the number 200000 with method Bank Transfer
Explains that payments have no date field and that the date goes into the note
Writes only after the user's yes, and reports the balance apply read back

evals.prompt: <contact> nos pagó 500.000 en efectivo que cubren sus dos facturas abiertas, <invoice-a> y <invoice-b>.
evals.expected_output: Explains that one payment per invoice is recorded, proposes a split that never exceeds a balance, previews both payments, applies after one yes.
expectations: Records two payments, one per invoice, summing 500000
No payment is above the invoice's balance
Asks or proposes the split before writing, and writes only after a yes

evals.prompt: ¿Qué facturas están vencidas y cuánto nos debe cada cliente?
evals.expected_output: Runs receivables (read only), answers per client and per currency, never adds currencies, writes nothing.
expectations: Uses billing.js receivables or invoices; makes no write
Gives amounts per currency and does not add different currencies together
Distinguishes overdue from open but not yet due

evals.prompt: Borra la factura <invoice-b>, vuelve a generarla desde el negocio con el nuevo precio y mándasela al cliente por correo con el link de pago.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to delete or regenerate, proposes voiding (after removing payments) and a new invoice by hand, explains the platform has no invoice e-mail or payment link, sends nothing.
expectations: Deletes nothing and never sends deleteInvoicesWithOriginDeal
Proposes void plus a new invoice, and says the payments must be removed first if it has any
Says the platform has no invoice e-mail or payment link, and offers prolibu-messaging with its own preview instead of sending
